ITEM 1 | Large plate-based pasta portion: short tube pasta (penne-like) with pale golden-yellow color, glossy and lightly coated, pieces about 2-3 cm long, scattered across upper right of plate, slightly oily sheen | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark brown rectangular piece with slightly glossy, caramelized surface and firm texture, about 4 cm by 2.5 cm, sitting at upper left of the pasta area, appears to be seared or glazed | 45
ITEM 3 | Wilted dark green leafy vegetable (greens) with darker crinkled edges, clustered between pasta and yellow slices, moist-looking, about 5 cm across | 25
ITEM 4 | Thin yellow citrus-like slices, pale yellow with lighter rind edges, slightly curled, about 4 cm diameter each, two or three pieces stacked near the pasta | 15
ITEM 5 | Light tan cubes of firm, lightly browned tofu-like or bread-like pieces, about 2 cm cubes, dry-looking surface, at right edge of plate | 20
ITEM 6 | Pale golden-green baked casserole portion of rice or grain mixed with herbs and small green flecks, moist and clumpy, holding shape in a mound about 9 cm by 7 cm, slightly crusted top | 170
ITEM 7 | Pink-orange flaky fish fillet pieces partially covered by the rice mixture, moist, separating into flakes, two pieces about 4 cm by 3 cm each, edges slightly golden | 90
ITEM 8 | Brown sauce or pan juices with small dark specks around pasta and rice, thin film, glossy, spread along plate edges | 10
